content.title: Sinclair, Nexstar Will Bring Kimmel Back to Their ABC Affiliates
content.summary: Sinclair  and  Nexstar Media Group  are putting  Jimmy Kimmel  back on the air.  The TV broadcasters, which combined own and operate more than 60 ABC affiliates in markets including Washington, D.C., New Orleans, Seattle and St. Louis, will end their pre-emption of “Jimmy Kimmel Live!” and air the late-night show again beginning Friday.  ABC suspended the show earlier this month after remarks Kimmel made about the killing of conservative activist and podcast host  Charlie Kirk.
